title: Chip family
description: config/chips/<producer>/<family>.yml: one chip family of one producer — its chips, and the toolchains that build for them (a chip may name its own).

Producer.description: The producer's name as board_producers.yml knows it (Name, an AKA or the Id)

DefaultToolchains.description: Toolchains every chip of the family builds with, as <toolchain>[<version constraint>]

Id.description: The part number as the vendor writes it

Toolchains.description: This chip's toolchains when they differ from the family's
